root_cause: R0 contract mandates strict FIFO execution but synthetic evidence demonstrates FIFO violates business objective of reducing deadline breaches without increasing hours
suggested_requirement_change: Replace FIFO with deadline-first FIFO tiebreaker (scheduling_precedence=deadline_first_fifo_tiebreak) while preserving arrival_order only for deadline ties
compliance_questions: Does FIFO implementation contradict business objective of reducing deadline breaches?
Can arrival_order be modified to prioritize deadlines while maintaining FIFO for same-deadline cases?
